what: An OP-1-style workflow for the FM-1: play, record and layer full songs on 6 tracks in real time, with no quantizing, plus a step sequencer. EDIT opens a Vital-style two-wave synth: design a sound, then send it to a track. Simple project and sound saving, on-screen tips. Based on Skiff.
author: James
sounds: CC0: instrument samples from Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL; drums synthesized by Felucca's own generator (Hügelton Sample Pack, GPL-3.0-only); Skiff's SLICE drum loops (GPL-3.0-only) are in the repository only, not in the FM-1 package. All kept from Skiff.
